research.scope: Full read of the pinned source manifest under source/: README.md, package.json, index.html, vite.config.js, tsconfig.json, .gitignore, src/index.ts, src/App.tsrx (all 763 lines), src/includes/store.ts, src/includes/utils.ts, and src/includes/Icon.tsrx (first 80 lines); directory listings of source/ and source/src/. research.summary: The pinned upstream tree at commit 539881b (github.com/lakhindarpal/bookmark-manager, materialized under source/) is a client-only bookmark manager built with Ripple TS, Vite, Tailwind/DaisyUI, Valibot, and Dexie/IndexedDB. A single Bookmark record type carries id, title, url, hostname, favicon Blob, description, flat tags[], isPinned, isArchived, visitCount, createdAt, visitedAt (source/src/includes/store.ts:3-16). The DB 'BookmarkDB' v1 has one table 'bookmarks' keyed by id with createdAt and visitCount indexes (source/src/includes/store.ts:41-47). The single component App.tsrx implements: an add/edit dialog with Valibot validation (URL http/https, title, description, 1-5 tags), a library grid with Home/Archived tabs, tag-filter sidebar with per-tag counts, title-only search, three sort modes with pinned-first, Visit (increments visitCount/visitedAt then window.open), Copy URL, Pin/Unpin, Edit, Archive/Unarchive, and a Delete action available only on archived items with a 5-second Undo toast. Metadata/favicons are fetched opportunistically from third-party services (api.microlink.io, images.weserv.nl, Google favicon) behind a 'sparkles' button and a fallback path, with failures only console.error'd. No test files, no import/export, no collections/folders, no sync, no preserved page copies, and no test script exist in the supplied manifest.

observations.statement: New records are built with id `bm-${crypto.randomUUID()}`, hostname from getHostname(url), and defaults visitCount=0, visitedAt=null, isPinned=false, isArchived=false, createdAt=Date.now(); edits preserve the previous id, isPinned, isArchived, visitCount, createdAt, and visitedAt.
Pin/Unpin and Edit actions are rendered only when the item is not archived, and Edit loads the item's url/title/description/tags/favicon into the dialog.

The Valibot BookmarkFormSchema requires a non-empty URL matching /^https?:\/\/(?:[\w-]+\.)+[a-zA-Z]{2,}(?:\/\S*)?$/ and v.url, a non-empty title up to 100 chars, a non-empty description up to 280 chars, and 1-5 tags each up to 30 chars.
Tab, tag filters, sort, and search are held in component-local tracked state initialized to 'Home', [], 'Recently Added', and '' respectively, with no persistence to Dexie.

assumptions: No collection concept exists outside the Bookmark fields and App.tsrx UI.
location.reasoning: The data model exposes only tags[] for organization, the form caps tags at five, and the sidebar only renders tag checkboxes rather than a collection tree; reclassification happens by editing the tag list.

observations.statement: The scenario's user-controlled 'category' (归类) is realized only as up to five free-text tags on each record; there are no creatable, renameable, or nestable collections, and no separate move operation beyond editing tags.
saveBookmark sets the record in the in-memory map then awaits db.bookmarks.put(bm); deleteBookmark removes from the map then awaits db.bookmarks.delete(id).

assumptions: saveBookmark uses put with a newly generated id for every add, so identical URLs are distinct rows.
location.reasoning: The schema indexes id, createdAt, and visitCount, not url, and each add generates a fresh `bm-${crypto.randomUUID()}` id.

observations.statement: Duplicate records for the same URL can accumulate because the url field is neither uniquely indexed nor checked before insert; only id (a random UUID) is the key.
A Delete action is rendered only for archived items; it calls deleteBookmark and shows an error-type toast with an Undo action that calls saveBookmark(item) to restore the record.

getHostname returns '' unless the URL matches an http/https regex with a dotted domain, otherwise returns new URL(url).hostname; getBlobUrl caches object URLs per Blob in a WeakMap; formatDate returns 'Never' for falsy timestamps else a locale date string.
A Dexie database named 'BookmarkDB' version 1 declares a single 'bookmarks' EntityTable keyed by id and indexed on createdAt and visitCount.
index.html defines the #root div and loads /src/index.ts as a module for the Bookmark Manager SPA.

location.host_classification: Fixed documentation file; no implementation or runtime claim.

observations.statement: README describes the app as local-first with bookmarks stored in IndexedDB and featuring tagging, sorting by recently added/visited/most visited, and archiving/pinning.

assumptions: Users cannot bypass the schema, since submit always calls v.safeParse before saving.
location.reasoning: The tags schema enforces v.minLength(1), so a record cannot be stored without at least one tag, leaving no 'unsorted' inbox path.

observations.statement: The scenario step of letting unclassified links land in a default category is not supported, because the form schema rejects saves with zero tags.
A Copy URL action writes item.url to the clipboard and shows a success toast.

assumptions: The user may submit without pressing the metadata button, in which case only the submitted fields are stored.
location.reasoning: Both the metadata fetch and the favicon fallback are wrapped in try/catch that only log, and submission proceeds to build the record regardless of enrichment success.

observations.statement: Metadata and favicon enrichment is best-effort and dependent on third-party HTTP services; failures degrade silently to console errors while the bookmark still saves with whatever fields the user entered or omitted defaults for.
An effect on component creation calls db.bookmarks.toArray() and inserts each returned bookmark into an in-memory RippleMap keyed by bookmark id.
On submit, if no favicon exists and a hostname is derivable, the code fetches a Google s2 favicon proxied through images.weserv.nl inside a try/catch that only logs failure.

assumptions: IndexedDB storage is not shared or synchronized across browsers/devices by the app.
location.reasoning: The only storage mechanism declared is a local Dexie/IndexedDB database and the README frames the design as local-first with no accounts or servers.

observations.statement: Persistence is local to one browser profile/device via IndexedDB with no sync layer, so the scenario's cross-session growth holds only on the same browser, and the leaf's multi-device context is unmet.

assumptions: No other delete entry point exists in the manifest.
location.reasoning: The Delete <li> is inside the if (item.isArchived) block, and restoration is bound solely to the toast's Undo onClick, which disappears when the toast auto-expires in five seconds.

observations.statement: Deletion is limited to archived records and recovery is only the transient Undo action on the toast; there is no trash view, and non-archived records cannot be deleted at all through the UI.
The Visit action builds an updated bookmark with visitedAt=Date.now() and visitCount+1, calls saveBookmark(updated), then opens the URL with window.open(item.url, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer').

The displayed list filters by isArchived matching the active tab, requires every selected tag to be present in bookmark.tags, matches search only against bookmark.title.toLowerCase(), and sorts pinned-first then by the chosen sort mode with createdAt descending as fallback.
The Bookmark type stores id, title, url, hostname, favicon Blob, description, tags string array, isPinned, isArchived, visitCount, createdAt, and visitedAt.
The entry point imports index.css, mounts the App component into #root via ripple's mount, and throws if the root element is missing.
The Archive/Unarchive action toggles isArchived and, when archiving, forces isPinned=false before saving.
Tag counts are derived by iterating all in-memory bookmarks and counting each tag occurrence, then sorted alphabetically for the sidebar.

assumptions: Tag names are found only via the sidebar checkbox filter, not via the text search.
location.reasoning: The filter clause applies _search exclusively to bookmark.title.toLowerCase().

observations.statement: Retrieval by keyword covers only bookmark titles, not URLs, descriptions, or tag names, so the scenario's 'find by a remembered word' workflow is partially supported.

assumptions: Dexie over IndexedDB persists between sessions in the user's browser profile.
RippleMap reactivity renders the loaded records as the grid of articles.
location.reasoning: Records are persisted on save and re-read on mount into the reactive map that drives the filtered/sorted list; the Visit action reopens the stored URL, closing the retrieve-and-return loop.

observations.statement: The app supports the scenario's save-now/find-later loop: a deliberate add dialog writes a URL-anchored record into durable IndexedDB, and the record can later be browsed, tag-filtered, title-searched, and opened back to the live URL.

fetchMeta calls https://api.microlink.io/?url=... and, on success with result.data, sets title/description and fetches the logo through https://images.weserv.nl/; errors are only console.error'd and the finally block resets loading.
package.json scripts are start, dev, build, lint, typecheck, serve, format, and check; there is no test script and no test dependency.

scenario_links.reason: The repository implements the scenario's core loop of deliberately saving a URL as a durable record, organizing it, retrieving it later, and returning to the original page. However, the scenario's 'category' (归类) concept maps only onto a mandatory flat tag list rather than creatable/movable collections, there is no default/unsorted category because at least one tag is required, and search covers only the title. Persistence is single-browser IndexedDB with no sync, so the multi-device aspect of the scenario is not supported.
workflow_support: Save a seen link: Add Bookmark dialog captures URL with Valibot validation (source/src/App.tsrx:101-129, source/src/App.tsrx:658-717).
Choose a simple category: up to five free-text tags are entered in the dialog (source/src/App.tsrx:608-657).

Browse or search the personal library: Home/Archived tabs, tag checkbox filters with counts, and a title-search field (source/src/App.tsrx:49-56, source/src/App.tsrx:58-88, source/src/App.tsrx:241-250).
Move/manage organization after saving: Edit reopens the record and rewrites tags via saveBookmark (source/src/App.tsrx:392-412, source/src/App.tsrx:699-714).
Open a record to return to the original page: Visit updates visitedAt/visitCount and calls window.open(item.url, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer') (source/src/App.tsrx:339-354).
Persistence across sessions: records are written to Dexie table 'bookmarks' and re-read with db.bookmarks.toArray() on mount (source/src/includes/store.ts:41-47, source/src/App.tsrx:23-32).
